emotional_tone: Professional, Safe, Trustworthy, Elegant, and Inviting

brand.name: Nusantara Travel
brand.core_promise: Solusi Rental Mobil & Tour Terpercaya untuk Perjalanan Anda

headings.usage_rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings. Never center unless explicitly necessary. Maintain strong hierarchy.

body.usage_rules: Use leading-relaxed for body copy to enhance readability.

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Always favor p-8 or p-12 inside cards. Avoid cramming elements.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons and badges
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Use asymmetric 'Bento' grids (cols-1 md:cols-12) for the 'Services' section to create visual interest. Standard grids (cols-1 md:cols-3) for Cars and Tour Packages.

surface_strategies.navbar: Glassmorphism: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50. Sticky to top with z-50.
surface_strategies.cards: Solid background (white or light gray) with a subtle 1px border (border-slate-200). On hover, elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) and add soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]).
surface_strategies.hero_overlay: Gradient overlay from left to right: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0A2045]/90 via-[#0A2045]/60 to-transparent. Never use a flat black blanket overlay.
surface_strategies.footer: Dark Theme for contrast: bg-[#0A2045] with white text.

animations.scroll: Use framer-motion for smooth, staggered fade-up entrances. Incorporate Lenis for smooth browser scrolling if possible.
animations.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. For images in cards (Cars, Destinations), apply group-hover:scale-105 with duration-700 ease-out.

icons.style: Use 'regular' or 'duotone' weight for a premium, polished look.

buttons.primary: bg-[#005CE6] text-white hover:bg-[#0047B3] px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-semibold transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#0F172A] border border-slate-300 hover:border-[#0F172A] px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-semibold transition-all
buttons.whatsapp: fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform z-50 flex items-center justify-center

components.navbar: Sticky header. Left: Brand Logo/Text. Center: Hidden on mobile, flex on desktop with gap-8 (Home, Tentang, Rental, Tour, Galeri, Kontak). Right: CTA Booking button.
components.hero: Full viewport height or min-h-[85vh]. Left-aligned text content. Staggered reveal. High quality SUV background image.
components.services_bento: 4 items. Item 1 (Rental Harian): col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2. Item 2 (Paket Tour): col-span-full md:col-span-4. etc.
components.car_card: Vertical layout. Top: Image (h-48 object-cover rounded-t-2xl). Body: Title, Price (prominent), 3x inline specs (Seats, Transmission, Fuel with icons). Bottom: Sewa Sekarang CTA.
components.tour_card: Image focused. Text overlaid or clean bottom section. Must have a hover-zoom effect on the image.
components.why_us: 4 column grid. Large phosphor duotone icons, bold heading, short description.
components.gallery: Grid layout with no gaps or very tight gaps, images scale on hover.
components.testimonials: Use a slider/carousel for cards containing 5-star icons, user text, and name. Clean white background for cards.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. E.g., data-testid='booking-cta-hero', data-testid='nav-link-tour', data-testid='whatsapp-float'.

hero.description: Luxury SUV parked on rooftop at sunset. Use this as the main hero background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement scroll animations using framer-motion (fade up, stagger effects).
Ensure the sticky navbar has a backdrop blur and a z-index of 50.
Implement the 'floating WhatsApp' button as fixed positioned with its proper green brand color (#25D366).
Build a clean bento-grid for the Services (Layanan Kami) instead of symmetric squares.
Ensure the hero overlay is a dark blue gradient to transparent, NOT a solid black opacity. This ensures text readability while showcasing the image.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Apply 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text via Google Fonts import.
Use standard semantic HTML sections (section, nav, footer) alongside pure Tailwind classes for maximum control over layouts.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, nav links, and interactive cards for testing.
